name: Mod Updater
description: Adds update checking to Settings > Mods. A Check for updates button next to the search box asks every installed mod's source for its current version; when newer versions exist the button turns into Install all updates and each affected mod gets its own Update button. Two switches under the version-check bypass let the shell check automatically after boot and every few hours, notify you, and optionally install what it finds.
author: drpezzer
permissions: Contacts the source of each installed mod (local directory, git remote, or raw.githubusercontent.com) to read its current manifest when you check for updates or have automatic checks on
Installs mod updates through the mod manager's own update path, which rebuilds the shell generation
Sends notifications through Ambxst's notification service when automatic checks find updates
